What is: Schein's 3 levels of culture
HR Courses Online · 2:11 · 3,489 views · Watch ↗
Read transcript · ~426 words

shines three levels of culture are a framework proposed by Edgar shine a renowned organizational psychologist and management scholar the model helps in understanding and analyzing the different aspects of culture within an organization the three levels are as follows artifacts and behaviors this level is the top level and represents the visible and tangible aspects of culture including the physical environment dress code office layout symbols rituals and observable behaviors these elements are easily noticeable and provide initial insights into an organization's culture however they may not fully reveal the underlying beliefs and values that drive these behaviors espoused values the second level consists of the espoused values which are the explicitly stated beliefs philosophies and Norms that an organization professes to follow these values are often articulated through mission statements corporate policies and official documents they represent the desired principles that guide decision making goal setting and behavior within the organization however there may be a gap between espoused values and the actual values that are practiced basic assumptions and shared beliefs the deepest level of culture comprises the basic assumptions and shared beliefs that are ingrained in the organization these assumptions are often taken for granted and operate at a subconscious level they reflect the fundamental beliefs attitudes and values that shape the organization's culture basic assumptions are rarely discussed or explicitly stated but greatly influence how people think behave and interact within the organization according to shine the deeper the level the more difficult it is to perceive and understand the culture the outer levels artifacts and espoused values are more visible and accessible while the inner level basic assumptions requires a deeper exploration and Analysis to uncover the underlying beliefs that drive organizational behavior understanding these three levels can provide valuable insights into the culture of an organization and help facilitate change or alignment with desired cultural values
